query: Before I merge this branch, audit plugins/example-plugin/skills/release-notes/SKILL.md for Agent Skills spec compliance, progressive disclosure, and description quality.
Review the implementation in src/release-notes.ts for bugs, security issues, and missing unit tests before I open a PR.
Can you lint the ExampleCo agent plugin in plugins/example-plugin and give me the L1 failures, L2 metrics, and the highest-value L3 fixes?
Run the release-notes skill against these five prompts and compare its answers with the old version so we can measure whether behavior improved.
Does this SKILL.md load too much context up front? Audit its references, scripts, Gotchas section, and trigger description, but do not change anything.
Read docs/agent-architecture.md and critique whether our coordinator-and-worker design is too complex for the ExampleCo support bot.
Please do a marketplace-tier audit of ./plugins/example-plugin and tell me whether it clears the static privacy and packaging gate.
Decide whether ExampleCo's plugin is fully ready to publish, including running behavioral tests, judging answer quality, and making the final promotion decision.
triage this skill folder for me: plugins/example-plugin/skills/incident-helper. i mostly care about broken frontmatter, portability, and quick wins
Triage the open bug in ExampleCo's incident service: requests intermittently return 502 after the retry middleware change.
Check whether every skill exposed by .agents/plugins/marketplace.json follows the open Agent Skills format and report harness-specific findings separately.
Validate this marketplace.json as ordinary JSON and fix any duplicate keys or malformed package URLs you find.
I shortened the description in plugins/example-plugin/skills/oncall/SKILL.md. Audit it for under-triggering, collisions with adjacent skills, and anti-trigger clarity.
Rewrite the on-call assistant system prompt so it sounds friendlier and gives shorter answers to ExampleCo employees.
Do a read-only --tier toolshed review of the ExampleCo plugin and return only the prioritized quick wins from the skill audit.
Scan the ExampleCo web application dependencies for known CVEs and produce a remediation plan for the engineering team.
Is this skill over-prescriptive? Review SKILL.md plus only the referenced files needed to assess its workflow and authoring craft.
Proofread the ExampleCo employee handbook for unclear sentences, inconsistent capitalization, and overly prescriptive policy language.
Audit the plugin before release and verify that skill names match directories, descriptions state when to trigger, and bundled resources use progressive disclosure.
Inspect the git diff for the ExampleCo CLI release and tell me whether the code change is backward compatible with the current API.
